exclusions: Luxury amenity charges (television, telephone, guest meals)

clauses.title: First-Day Coverage Waiver
clauses.text: All pre-existing conditions and initial 30-day waiting period restrictions are waived from day one of corporate employment enrollment.

clauses.title: Maternity Benefit Sub-Limit
clauses.text: Maternity and caesarean claims are covered up to a maximum aggregate limit of INR 75,000 per policy year.
